verdict.rationale: The docs describe official programmatic surfaces for managing agents: the ElevenLabs API, an Agents CLI, a hosted MCP server and an agents skill for coding assistants. Embedding in websites or apps and client-side tools running in browsers or mobile apps suggest client libraries exist, but no official SDK is ever named or documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs (e.g. language or platform packages and install steps), SDK reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of building with an SDK.
